1. {"action": "read", "path": "ReplicatedStorage/Upgrades.luau", "why": "Upgrade costs data lives here; check listed costs vs spec"}
Result: -- Upgrades: pure data for the dropper / ore tier / speed / cash multiplier tree.
-- No requires, no side effects. Returns { list = {...}, byId = {...}, ores = {...}, starterCash = n }.
--
-- This table is the SINGLE source of truth for upgrade prices. Shop cards, world pads, the
-- server purchase check, the tutorial text and the HUD "Next:" hint must all read cost from here.
-- Dropper 2 = 10, Speed 1 (Fast Belt) = 20 and Dropper 3 = 40, so a purchase lands roughly
-- every 8-10 s in the first minute. The player starts with 0 cash (Config.STARTING_CASH must
-- match), so the first two collected cubes earn the first purchase.
--
-- BUDGET MATH
--   The first cube (Bronze) is worth 5 cash. The player starts with 0 cash, so the first buy
--   (Dropper 2, 10 cash) is earned by the first two cubes, which fills the HUD goal bar before
--   the pad turns green. After Dropper 2, income is 5 cash/s (2 cubes per 2 s cycle x 5 cash).
--   Total cost of all 10 upgrades:
--     10 + 20 + 60 + 40 + 300 + 500 + 800 + 1300 + 2200 + 4000 = 9230 cash
--   Income after each milestone (cubes per 2 s cycle x ore value x cash multiplier, per second),
--   and the approximate wait for the NEXT purchase at that income:
--     base                        1 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   2.5 /s   (Dropper 2, 10 -> ~4 s)
--     dropper2                    2 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   5   /s   (Speed 1, 20  -> ~4 s)
--     speed1                                           5   /s   (Dropper 3, 40 -> ~8 s)
--     dropper3                    3 x 5  x 1.0 / 2 =   7.5 /s   (Silver, 60 -> ~8 s)
--     tier_silver                 3 x 12 x 1.0 / 2 =  18   /s   (Cash x1.5, 300 -> ~17 s)
--     mult1 (x1.5)                3 x 12 x 1.5 / 2 =  27   /s   (Gold, 500 -> ~18 s)
--     tier_gold                   3 x 30 x 1.5 / 2 =  67.5 /s   (Speed 2, 800 -> ~12 s)
--     speed2                                          67.5 /s   (Dropper 4, 1300 -> ~19 s)
--     dropper4                    4 x 30 x 1.5 / 2 =  90   /s   (Cash x2, 2200 -> ~24 s)
--     mult2 (x2)                  4 x 30 x 2.0 / 2 = 120   /s   (Diamond, 4000 -> ~33 s)
--     tier_diamond                4 x 75 x 2.0 / 2 = 300   /s
--   (speed upgrades only shorten the trip to the collector.)
--
-- Effect shapes:
--   { kind = "dropper",  slots = n }   total active dropper slots after purchase
--   { kind = "tier",     tier = n }    ore tier every dropper spits out (index into ores)
--   { kind = "speed",    mult = x }    conveyor speed multiplier
--   { kind = "cashMult", mult = x }    collector cash multiplier
--
-- Optional presentation fields (read by the client for the purchase celebration):
--   label  = short headline string
--   popup  = RewardPopup text (shown with Win sting, shockwave ring and FOV punch for ore tiers)
--   color  = Color3 for the shockwave ring / popup (ore tiers)
--
-- Every `requires` points at an existing id, so pads reveal progressively.

local list = {
	{ id = "dropper2", name = "Dropper 2", cost = 10, requires = nil, effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 2 } },
	{ id = "speed1", name = "Speed 1", cost = 20, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "speed", mult = 1.5 } },
	{
		id = "tier_silver",
		name = "Silver Ore",
		cost = 60,
		requires = "dropper2",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 2 },
		label = "Silver Ore",
		popup = "SILVER ORE! $12 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 220),
	},
	{ id = "dropper3", name = "Dropper 3", cost = 40, requires = "dropper2", effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 3 } },
	{ id = "mult1", name = "Cash x1.5", cost = 300, requires = "tier_silver", effect = { kind = "cashMult", mult = 1.5 } },
	{
		id = "tier_gold",
		name = "Gold Ore",
		cost = 500,
		requires = "tier_silver",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 3 },
		label = "Gold Ore",
		popup = "GOLD ORE! $30 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40),
	},
	{ id = "speed2", name = "Speed 2", cost = 800, requires = "speed1", effect = { kind = "speed", mult = 2 } },
	{ id = "dropper4", name = "Dropper 4", cost = 1300, requires = "dropper3", effect = { kind = "dropper", slots = 4 } },
	{ id = "mult2", name = "Cash x2", cost = 2200, requires = "mult1", effect = { kind = "cashMult", mult = 2 } },
	{
		id = "tier_diamond",
		name = "Diamond Ore",
		cost = 4000,
		requires = "tier_gold",
		effect = { kind = "tier", tier = 4 },
		label = "Diamond Ore",
		popup = "DIAMOND ORE! $75 per cube",
		color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 255),
	},
}

-- Indexed by tier.
local ores = {
	{ name = "Bronze", value = 5, color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 127, 50), material = Enum.Material.Metal, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Silver", value = 12, color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 210, 220), material = Enum.Material.Metal, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Gold", value = 30, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40), material = Enum.Material.Foil, sparkles = false },
	{ name = "Diamond", value = 75, color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 235, 255), material = Enum.Material.Glass, sparkles = true },
}

local byId = {}
for _, upgrade in ipairs(list) do
	byId[upgrade.id] = upgrade
end

-- Sanity check: every requirement must reference an existing upgrade id.
for _, upgrade in ipairs(list) do
	if upgrade.requires ~= nil and byId[upgrade.requires] == nil then
		warn("[Upgrades] " .. upgrade.id .. " requires unknown id " .. tostring(upgrade.requires))
	end
end

return {
	list = list,
	byId = byId,
	ores = ores,
	-- Starter grant: 0, so the first two collected $5 cubes earn Dropper 2 (10). Keep Config.STARTING_CASH in sync.
	starterCash = 0,
}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local byId: { [string]: any } = {}
for _, u in ipairs(list) do

local function ensureRemote(name: string): RemoteEvent
	local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return existing
	end
	local r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	r.Name = name
	r.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	return r
end
local buyRemote: RemoteEvent = ensureRemote("BuyUpgrade")
local shopSync: RemoteEvent = ensureRemote("ShopSync")
local shopCooldown: { [Player]: number } = {}
local SHOP_COOLDOWN = 0.3

local PlotGrowth: any = nil
do
	local growthModule = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("PlotGrowth")
	if growthModule then
		local okReq, res = pcall(require, growthModule)
		if okReq then
			PlotGrowth = res
		end
	end
end

local function growPlot(player: Player, plot: any, owned: { [string]: boolean })
	if PlotGrowth == nil or type(PlotGrowth.apply) ~= "function" or plot == nil then
		return
	end
	local ownedIds: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for id, v in pairs(owned) do
		if v then
			ownedIds[id] = true
		end
	end
	local target: any = plot
	if typeof(plot) ~= "Instance" then
		target = type(plot) == "table" and plot.model or nil
	end
	if target == nil then
		return
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(PlotGrowth.apply, player, target, ownedIds)
	if not ok then
		warn("[UpgradeService] PlotGrowth.apply failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

local function pickColor(t: any, keys: { string }, default: Color3): Color3
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return default
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
		if typeof(t[k]) == "Color3" then
			return t[k]
		end
	end
	return default
end

local function num(t: any, keys: { string }, default: number): number
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return default
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
		if type(t[k]) == "number" then
			return t[k]
		end
	end
	return default
end

local function kindOf(u: any): string
	local e = u.effect
	if type(e) == "table" and type(e.kind) == "string" then
		return string.lower(e.kind)
	end
	return ""
end

local function computeMods(owned: { [string]: boolean })
	local slots, ore, speed, cash = 1, 1, 1, 1
	for id in pairs(owned) do
		local u = byId[id]
		if u then
			local k = kindOf(u)
			local e = u.effect
			if k == "slot" or k == "dropper" then
				slots += 1
			elseif k == "tier" then
				ore = math.max(ore, num(e, { "tier", "ore", "value" }, 1))
			elseif k == "speed" or k == "conveyor" then
				speed *= num(e, { "mult", "value", "speed" }, 1)
			elseif k == "cashmult" or k == "cash" or k == "multiplier" then
				cash = math.max(cash, num(e, { "mult", "value", "cashMult" }, 1))
			end
		end
	end
	return { slots = slots, ore = ore, speedMult = speed, cashMult = cash }
end

local ORE_FALLBACK_NAMES = { "Bronze", "Silver", "Gold", "Platinum", "Diamond" }

-- publishes the player's current modifiers as attributes so the client HUD can read state
local function publishMods(player: Player, owned: { [string]: boolean }, mods: any)
	local oreTier = mods.ore
	local oreName: string? = nil
	for id in pairs(owned) do
		local u = byId[id]
		if u and kindOf(u) == "tier" and type(u.effect) == "table" then
			local e = u.effect
			if num(e, { "tier", "ore", "value" }, 1) == oreTier then
				if type(e.oreName) == "string" then
					oreName = e.oreName
				elseif type(e.name) == "string" then
					oreName = e.name
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if oreName == nil then
		oreName = ORE_FALLBACK_NAMES[oreTier] or ("Tier " .. tostring(oreTier))
	end
	player:SetAttribute("OreName", oreName)
	player:SetAttribute("DropperSlots", mods.slots)
	player:SetAttribute("CashMult", mods.cashMult)
end

-- Shared constants for Cube Cash Tycoon. Single source of truth for tunables.
-- NOTE: upgrade prices AND per-ore cube values live ONLY in ReplicatedStorage/Upgrades.luau
-- (Upgrades.ores). Do not add costs or ore values here.
-- Economy summary (see Upgrades.luau for the authoritative numbers): the player starts with
-- no cash and the first (Bronze) ore pays CUBE_VALUE per cube, so the first purchase
-- (Dropper 2) is earned from the first few collected cubes within ~10s.

local Config = {
	-- Economy
	-- Start at 0 so the first buy is earned. Starting cash must stay below the first
	-- upgrade's price (Dropper 2), otherwise the player can spend instantly with no chase.
	STARTING_CASH = 0,

	-- Cubes / dropping
	DROP_INTERVAL = 2, -- seconds between cubes per dropper (design: one cube every 2s)
	-- FALLBACK ONLY: real cube values come from Upgrades.ores (the first/Bronze ore).
	-- Kept equal to the Bronze value so any code that still reads it shows the right number.
	-- Dropper, collector, HUD and tutorial should read Upgrades.ores instead.
	CUBE_VALUE = 5,
	CUBE_SIZE = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5),
	MAX_CUBES_PER_PLOT = 30,

	-- Conveyor
	CONVEYOR_SPEED = 8,
	FAST_CONVEYOR_SPEED = 16,
	CONVEYOR_LENGTH = 24,

	-- Plots
	PLOT_SIZE = Vector3.new(64, 1, 64),
	PLOT_SPACING = 60,
	MAX_PLOTS = 6, -- one plot per theme (6 themes), no repeats
	PLOT_COUNT = 6,

	-- Colors (palette only, no grey)
	PLOT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 140),
	CONVEYOR_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(43, 45, 66), -- #2B2D42 deep navy
	CUBE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 63), -- #FFD23F
	DROPPER_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(127, 227, 255), -- #7FE3FF
	COLLECTOR_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 106, 43), -- #FF6A2B
	BUTTON_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(76, 217, 100), -- #4CD964
	BOUGHT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(242, 196, 107), -- #F2C46B (warm gold, never grey)

	-- World floor
	BASEPLATE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(116, 196, 98), -- bright grass green
	BASEPLATE_MATERIAL = Enum.Material.Grass,

	-- Remotes
	REMOTES_FOLDER = "TycoonRemotes",
	REMOTE_NOTIFY = "Notify",
}
